runner: run.sh: five 20-batch curation.asr_queue plans in sequence (asr_queue allows <=20 batches); any failure stops the chain; state-1..state-5
scope: Next unattempted rows from the deduplicated pool in pool order; excludes every audio hash in any remote-fil-asr-* JSONL and VAD v1. Nothing sent by selection.
recovery: Inspect state-N/worker.json and the actual process before recovery. Never restart a plan with a started batch; build a new frozen plan that excludes every attempted hash.
